# ============================================================
# SHARED OBJECTS
# ============================================================

safe_brm <- purrr::safely(brms::brm)

sex_cols <- c(
  female = "#b19cd9",
  male   = "#6a0dad"
)

sex_sig_cols <- c(
  female_sig    = "#b19cd9",
  male_sig      = "#6a0dad",
  female_nonsig = "#d9d9d9",
  male_nonsig   = "#8c8c8c"
)

treatment_cols <- c(
  Ctrl = "#0072B2",
  Hp   = "#E69F00"
)

priors <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b"),
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sd"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sigma")
)

# ============================================================
# SHARED HELPERS
# ============================================================

rename_eub_family <- function(ps, rank = "Family") {
  if (rank == "Family") {
    ps %>%
      mutate_tax_table(
        Family = ifelse(
          Family == "[Eubacterium] coprostanoligenes group",
          "Eub. coprostanoligenes gr.",
          Family
        )
      )
  } else if (rank == "Genus") {
    ps %>%
      mutate_tax_table(
        Genus = ifelse(
          Genus == "[Eubacterium] coprostanoligenes group",
          "Eub. coprostanoligenes gr.",
          Genus
        )
      )
  } else {
    ps
  }
}

rename_phyla <- function(ps) {
  ps %>%
    mutate_tax_table(
      Phylum = if_else(Phylum == "Firmicutes", "Bacillota", Phylum),
      Phylum = if_else(Phylum == "Proteobacteria", "Pseudomonadota", Phylum),
      Phylum = if_else(Phylum == "Actinobacteria", "Actinomycetota", Phylum)
    )
}

load_comp_physeq <- function(path) {
  readRDS(path) %>%
    subset_samples(!is.na(treatment)) %>%
    rename_phyla() %>%
    mutate_sample_data(seqSampleID = sample_names(.))
}

make_tax_names_unique <- function(ps, tax_level = "Family") {
  tax_names <- as.character(tax_table(ps)[, tax_level])
  tax_names[is.na(tax_names) | tax_names == ""] <- paste0("Unknown_", tax_level)
  taxa_names(ps) <- make.unique(tax_names)
  ps
}

make_family_clr_df <- function(physeq_obj,
                               sample_filter,
                               prevalence_threshold = 0.10,
                               max_abundance_threshold = 0.001) {
  filter_expr <- substitute(sample_filter)
  sample_df <- data.frame(sample_data(physeq_obj))
  keep_samples <- eval(filter_expr, sample_df, parent.frame())

  physeq_sub <- prune_samples(keep_samples, physeq_obj) %>%
    rename_eub_family(rank = "Family")

  physeq_fam <- phyloseq::tax_glom(physeq_sub, taxrank = "Family") %>%
    make_tax_names_unique("Family")

  otu_rel <- as(otu_table(physeq_fam), "matrix")
  if (!taxa_are_rows(physeq_fam)) otu_rel <- t(otu_rel)

  family_prevalence <- rowMeans(otu_rel > 0)
  family_max_abund  <- apply(otu_rel, 1, max)

  keep_families <- names(family_prevalence[
    family_prevalence >= prevalence_threshold &
      family_max_abund >= max_abundance_threshold
  ])

  physeq_fam <- prune_taxa(keep_families, physeq_fam)

  otu_rel <- as(otu_table(physeq_fam), "matrix")
  if (!taxa_are_rows(physeq_fam)) otu_rel <- t(otu_rel)

  min_nonzero <- min(otu_rel[otu_rel > 0])
  otu_rel_pc <- otu_rel + min_nonzero / 2
  otu_rel_pc <- sweep(otu_rel_pc, 2, colSums(otu_rel_pc), "/")
  otu_clr <- apply(otu_rel_pc, 2, compositions::clr)

  physeq_clr <- phyloseq(
    otu_table(otu_clr, taxa_are_rows = TRUE),
    tax_table(physeq_fam),
    sample_data(physeq_fam)
  )

  clr_df <- as.data.frame(otu_clr) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("Family") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(-Family, names_to = "Sample", values_to = "CLR") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      data.frame(sample_data(physeq_fam)) %>%
        tibble::rownames_to_column("Sample"),
      by = "Sample"
    )

  list(
    physeq_family = physeq_fam,
    physeq_clr = physeq_clr,
    clr_df = clr_df,
    kept_families = keep_families
  )
}

clr_phyloseq <- function(ps, tax_level = "Family") {
  ps <- rename_eub_family(ps, rank = tax_level)
  ps_glom <- tax_glom(ps, taxrank = tax_level) %>%
    make_tax_names_unique(tax_level)

  otu <- as(otu_table(ps_glom), "matrix")
  if (!taxa_are_rows(ps_glom)) otu <- t(otu)

  min_nonzero <- min(otu[otu > 0])
  otu_pc <- otu + min_nonzero / 2
  otu_pc <- sweep(otu_pc, 2, colSums(otu_pc), "/")
  otu_clr <- apply(otu_pc, 2, compositions::clr)

  phyloseq(
    otu_table(otu_clr, taxa_are_rows = TRUE),
    tax_table(ps_glom),
    sample_data(ps_glom)
  )
}

ps_clr_to_long <- function(ps_clr, tax_level = "Family") {
  psmelt(ps_clr) %>%
    rename(CLR = Abundance) %>%
    mutate(
      sex = factor(sex),
      treatment = factor(treatment),
      diet = factor(diet),
      !!tax_level := factor(.data[[tax_level]])
    )
}

make_rel_abund_df <- function(ps, tax_level = "Family", pseudocount = TRUE) {
  df <- ps %>%
    rename_eub_family(rank = tax_level) %>%
    phyloseq::tax_glom(taxrank = tax_level) %>%
    psmelt() %>%
    mutate(
      !!tax_level := ifelse(
        is.na(.data[[tax_level]]) | .data[[tax_level]] == "",
        paste0("Unknown_", tax_level),
        as.character(.data[[tax_level]])
      )
    )

  if (pseudocount) {
    min_nonzero <- min(df$Abundance[df$Abundance > 0], na.rm = TRUE)

    df <- df %>%
      mutate(
        pseudocount = min_nonzero / 2,
        Abundance_pseudocount = Abundance + pseudocount,
        abund_log10 = log10(Abundance_pseudocount)
      ) %>%
      select(-pseudocount)
  }

  df
}

fit_family_models <- function(clr_df, time_levels, priors) {
  model_df <- clr_df %>%
    mutate(
      timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = time_levels),
      sex = droplevels(factor(sex)),
      treatment = droplevels(factor(treatment)),
      Family = droplevels(factor(Family))
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(CLR))

  family_ids <- unique(model_df$Family)

  fit_models <- family_ids |>
    set_names() |>
    purrr::map(function(fam) {
      df_family <- model_df %>%
        filter(Family == fam) %>%
        droplevels()

      safe_brm(
        CLR ~ treatment * sex * timepoint + (1 | mouseID),
        data = df_family,
        family = student(),
        prior = priors,
        chains = 4,
        iter = 4000,
        warmup = 2000,
        backend = "cmdstanr",
        control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15)
      )
    })

  list(
    model_df = model_df,
    fit_models = fit_models
  )
}

extract_family_treatment_contrasts <- function(fit_models, time_levels) {
  plot_data <- purrr::imap_dfr(
    fit_models,
    function(fit, fam) {
      if (is.null(fit$result)) return(NULL)

      emm <- emmeans(fit$result, ~ treatment | sex * timepoint)
      emm_contr <- contrast(emm, method = "revpairwise")

      contr80 <- summary(emm_contr, level = 0.80) %>% as.data.frame()
      contr95 <- summary(emm_contr, level = 0.95) %>% as.data.frame()
      draws <- tidybayes::gather_emmeans_draws(emm_contr)

      prob_df <- draws %>%
        group_by(contrast, sex, timepoint) %>%
        summarise(
          p_gt0 = mean(.value > 0),
          p_lt0 = mean(.value < 0),
          prob_dir = pmax(p_gt0, p_lt0),
          .groups = "drop"
        )

      contr80 %>%
        transmute(
          Family = fam,
          sex,
          timepoint,
          contrast,
          median = estimate,
          CI80_low = lower.HPD,
          CI80_high = upper.HPD
        ) %>%
        left_join(
          contr95 %>%
            transmute(
              contrast,
              sex,
              timepoint,
              CI95_low = lower.HPD,
              CI95_high = upper.HPD
            ),
          by = c("contrast", "sex", "timepoint")
        ) %>%
        left_join(prob_df, by = c("contrast", "sex", "timepoint"))
    }
  )

  plot_data %>%
    mutate(
      timepoint = factor(as.character(timepoint), levels = time_levels),
      is_sig80 = (CI80_low > 0 | CI80_high < 0),
      is_sig95 = (CI95_low > 0 | CI95_high < 0)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(timepoint))
}

plot_family_treatment_effects <- function(plot_data,
                                          time_levels,
                                          ylab = "Hp − Ctrl effect (CLR)") {
  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    filter(!is.na(timepoint)) %>%
    mutate(timepoint = factor(as.character(timepoint), levels = time_levels))

  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = timepoint, y = median, group = sex, color = sex)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "#333333", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = CI80_low, ymax = CI80_high),
      width = 0.15,
      linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    geom_point(size = 1.3) +
    geom_point(
      data = ~ dplyr::filter(.x, is_sig80),
      shape = 21,
      stroke = 0.7,
      fill = "white",
      color = "black",
      size = 2.8
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = ~ dplyr::filter(.x, is_sig95),
      color = "black",
      size = 0.9,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ Family, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
    scale_color_manual(values = sex_cols) +
    scale_x_discrete(drop = TRUE) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "",
      y = ylab,
      color = "Sex"
    )
}

run_microbiome_model <- function(df, tax_level = "Family", prior_spec = priors) {
  form <- as.formula(
    paste0(
      "CLR ~ sex * treatment * diet + ",
      "(1 + sex * treatment * diet || ", tax_level, ")"
    )
  )

  brm(
    formula = form,
    data = df,
    family = student(),
    prior = prior_spec,
    chains = 4,
    iter = 4000,
    warmup = 2000,
    backend = "cmdstanr",
    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15)
  )
}

run_microbiome_model_no_diet <- function(df, tax_level = "Family", prior_spec = priors) {
  form <- as.formula(
    paste0(
      "CLR ~ sex * treatment + ",
      "(1 + sex * treatment || ", tax_level, ")"
    )
  )

  brm(
    formula = form,
    data = df,
    prior = prior_spec,
    family = gaussian(),
    backend = "cmdstanr"
  )
}

make_simple_effect_plot <- function(plot_df, title = NULL) {
  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = label, y = median, color = color_group)) +
    geom_linerange(
      aes(ymin = CI_low, ymax = CI_high),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    geom_linerange(
      aes(ymin = CI80_low, ymax = CI80_high),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
      linewidth = 1.8
    ) +
    geom_point(
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
      size = 1.8
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = ~ dplyr::filter(.x, is_sig80),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
      shape = 21,
      stroke = 0.7,
      fill = "white",
      color = "black",
      size = 2.8
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = ~ dplyr::filter(.x, is_sig95),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
      color = "black",
      size = 0.9,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    coord_flip() +
    facet_grid(rows = vars(Family)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = sex_sig_cols) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 8),
      strip.text.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "",
      y = "Effect estimate (CLR difference)",
      color = "Sex / Evidence",
      title = title
    )
}

clean_sample_id <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    stringr::str_remove("\\.sto$") %>%
    stringr::str_replace("\\.FL$", "_FL") %>%
    stringr::str_replace("\\.FN$", "_FN") %>%
    stringr::str_replace("\\.FR$", "_FR") %>%
    stringr::str_replace("\\.FB$", "_FB") %>%
    stringr::str_replace("\\.ML$", "_MN") %>%
    stringr::str_replace("\\.MR$", "_MR")
}

make_target_family_plot_list <- function(df_target, family_order) {
  df_plot <- df_target %>%
    mutate(
      abund_log10 = log10(Abundance + 1e-5),
      x_group = factor(
        paste(diet, treatment, sep = "_"),
        levels = c("CD_Ctrl", "CD_Hp", "HFD_Ctrl", "HFD_Hp")
      )
    )

  family_plots <- df_plot %>%
    split(.$Family) %>%
    purrr::imap(~ ggplot(.x, aes(x = x_group, y = abund_log10, color = treatment)) +
      geom_boxplot(
        aes(fill = treatment),
        alpha = 0.1,
        outlier.shape = NA,
        linewidth = 0.5,
        show.legend = FALSE
      ) +
      geom_jitter(height = 0, width = 0.12, size = 1, alpha = 0.6) +
      facet_wrap(~ sex) +
      scale_y_continuous(
        limits = c(-5.1, 0.2),
        breaks = c(-5, -4, -3, -2, -1, 0)
      ) +
      scale_colour_manual(
        labels = c("Control", expression(italic("H. pylori"))),
        values = treatment_cols
      ) +
      scale_fill_manual(
        labels = c("Control", expression(italic("H. pylori"))),
        values = treatment_cols
      ) +
      scale_x_discrete(labels = NULL) +
      annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 0.15, label = "CD", size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
      annotate("text", x = 3.5, y = 0.15, label = "HFD", size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 2.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey70") +
      labs(
        x = "",
        y = expression(Log[10] ~ "rel. abundance"),
        title = .y
      ) +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
        plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white"),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12, face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12)
      ) +
      guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3)))
    )

  family_plots_clean <- family_plots[intersect(family_order, names(family_plots))]
  family_plots_clean
}

assemble_family_patchwork <- function(family_plots_clean, ncol = 3, nrow = NULL) {
  keep_y <- seq(1, length(family_plots_clean), by = ncol)

  for (i in seq_along(family_plots_clean)) {
    if (!(i %in% keep_y)) {
      family_plots_clean[[i]] <- family_plots_clean[[i]] +
        theme(
          axis.title.y = element_blank(),
          axis.text.y  = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
        )
    }
  }

  wrap_plots(
    family_plots_clean,
    ncol = ncol,
    nrow = nrow
  ) +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}

make_top10_nested_bar <- function(ps_obj, facet_formula) {
  plot_nested_bar(
    ps_obj = ps_obj,
    top_level = "Phylum",
    nested_level = "Family",
    palette = c(
      Bacillota = "#00F034",
      Bacteroidota = "#008CF0",
      Campylobacterota = "#E69F00",
      Desulfobacterota = "#ECF000",
      Verrucomicrobiota = "#CA0BE8"
    )
  ) +
    labs(x = "Mouse ID", y = "Relative abundance") +
    facet_nested(
      facet_formula,
      nest_line = element_line(linetype = 1),
      scales = "free_x",
      space = "free",
      labeller = labeller(
        treatment = c("Ctrl" = "Control", "Hp" = "italic('H. pylori')"),
        .default = label_parsed
      )
    ) +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.ticks.length.x = unit(0.3, "cm"),
      strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      strip.text.x = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.5, "cm"),
      panel.spacing = unit(0.75, "lines"),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "white", fill = NA, size = 0.5)
    )
}

```{r}

# ============================================================
# SHORT-TERM EXPERIMENT, fecal samples
# ============================================================

# ---------- Baseline before diet change ----------
st_baseline_obj <- make_family_clr_df(
  physeq_obj = physeq_ST_comp,
  sample_filter = weeks_on_diet %in% c(-2, 0),
  prevalence_threshold = 0.10,
  max_abundance_threshold = 0.001
)

clr_ST_fam_df_baseline <- st_baseline_obj$clr_df

st_baseline_fit <- fit_family_models(
  clr_df = clr_ST_fam_df_baseline,
  time_levels = c("t0", "t1"),
  priors = priors
)

df_effects_ST_baseline <- extract_family_treatment_contrasts(
  fit_models = st_baseline_fit$fit_models,
  time_levels = c("t0", "t1")
)

p_family_treatment_effect_lines_baseline <- plot_family_treatment_effects(
  plot_data = df_effects_ST_baseline,
  time_levels = c("t0", "t1")
)

p_family_treatment_effect_lines_baseline

# ---------- Fecal samples one week after diet change ----------
st_fecal3_obj <- make_family_clr_df(
  physeq_obj = physeq_ST_comp,
  sample_filter = weeks_on_diet == 1,
  prevalence_threshold = 0.10,
  max_abundance_threshold = 0.001
)

clr_ST_fam_df_fecal3 <- st_fecal3_obj$clr_df

priors_fecal3 <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 2.5), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sigma")
)

fecal3_fam_clr <- clr_ST_fam_df_fecal3 %>%
  mutate(
    Family = droplevels(factor(Family)),
    sex = droplevels(factor(sex, levels = c("female", "male"))),
    treatment = droplevels(factor(treatment, levels = c("Ctrl", "Hp"))),
    diet = droplevels(factor(diet, levels = c("CD", "HFD")))
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(CLR))

family_ids_fecal3 <- unique(fecal3_fam_clr$Family)

fit_models_by_family_fecal3 <- family_ids_fecal3 |>
  set_names() |>
  purrr::map(function(fam) {
    df_family <- fecal3_fam_clr %>%
      filter(Family == fam) %>%
      droplevels()

    enough_levels <- (
      dplyr::n_distinct(df_family$sex) >= 2 &&
      dplyr::n_distinct(df_family$treatment) >= 2 &&
      dplyr::n_distinct(df_family$diet) >= 2
    )

    if (!enough_levels) {
      return(list(
        result = NULL,
        error = simpleError("Insufficient factor levels for full model")
      ))
    }

    safe_brm(
      CLR ~ treatment * diet + sex,
      data = df_family,
      family = student(),
      prior = priors_fecal3,
      chains = 4,
      iter = 4000,
      warmup = 2000,
      backend = "cmdstanr",
      control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15)
    )
  })

extract_fecal3_simple_effects <- function(fit_models) {
  diet_effects <- purrr::imap_dfr(
    fit_models,
    function(fit, fam) {
      if (is.null(fit$result)) return(NULL)

      emm <- emmeans::emmeans(fit$result, ~ diet | sex * treatment)
      emm_contr <- emmeans::contrast(emm, method = "revpairwise")

      summ80 <- summary(emm_contr, level = 0.80) %>% as.data.frame()
      summ95 <- summary(emm_contr, level = 0.95) %>% as.data.frame()
      draws  <- tidybayes::gather_emmeans_draws(emm_contr)

      prob_df <- draws %>%
        dplyr::group_by(contrast, sex, treatment) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(
          p_gt0 = mean(.value > 0),
          p_lt0 = mean(.value < 0),
          Pd = pmax(p_gt0, p_lt0),
          .groups = "drop"
        )

      summ80 %>%
        dplyr::transmute(
          contrast, sex, treatment,
          median = estimate,
          CI80_low = lower.HPD,
          CI80_high = upper.HPD
        ) %>%
        dplyr::left_join(
          summ95 %>%
            dplyr::transmute(
              contrast, sex, treatment,
              CI95_low = lower.HPD,
              CI95_high = upper.HPD
            ),
          by = c("contrast", "sex", "treatment")
        ) %>%
        dplyr::left_join(prob_df, by = c("contrast", "sex", "treatment")) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          Family = fam,
          label = paste0("Diet in ", treatment),
          type = "Simple Effects"
        ) %>%
        dplyr::transmute(
          Family, sex, median,
          CI_low = CI95_low,
          CI_high = CI95_high,
          CI80_low, CI80_high,
          CI95_low, CI95_high,
          Pd, label, type
        )
    }
  )

  treatment_effects <- purrr::imap_dfr(
    fit_models,
    function(fit, fam) {
      if (is.null(fit$result)) return(NULL)

      emm <- emmeans::emmeans(fit$result, ~ treatment | sex * diet)
      emm_contr <- emmeans::contrast(emm, method = "revpairwise")

      summ80 <- summary(emm_contr, level = 0.80) %>% as.data.frame()
      summ95 <- summary(emm_contr, level = 0.95) %>% as.data.frame()
      draws  <- tidybayes::gather_emmeans_draws(emm_contr)

      prob_df <- draws %>%
        dplyr::group_by(contrast, sex, diet) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(
          p_gt0 = mean(.value > 0),
          p_lt0 = mean(.value < 0),
          Pd = pmax(p_gt0, p_lt0),
          .groups = "drop"
        )

      summ80 %>%
        dplyr::transmute(
          contrast, sex, diet,
          median = estimate,
          CI80_low = lower.HPD,
          CI80_high = upper.HPD
        ) %>%
        dplyr::left_join(
          summ95 %>%
            dplyr::transmute(
              contrast, sex, diet,
              CI95_low = lower.HPD,
              CI95_high = upper.HPD
            ),
          by = c("contrast", "sex", "diet")
        ) %>%
        dplyr::left_join(prob_df, by = c("contrast", "sex", "diet")) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          Family = fam,
          label = paste0("Treatment in ", diet),
          type = "Simple Effects"
        ) %>%
        dplyr::transmute(
          Family, sex, median,
          CI_low = CI95_low,
          CI_high = CI95_high,
          CI80_low, CI80_high,
          CI95_low, CI95_high,
          Pd, label, type
        )
    }
  )

  dplyr::bind_rows(treatment_effects, diet_effects) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      is_sig80 = (CI80_low > 0 | CI80_high < 0),
      is_sig95 = (CI95_low > 0 | CI95_high < 0),
      color_group = dplyr::case_when(
        is_sig80 & sex == "female"  ~ "female_sig",
        is_sig80 & sex == "male"    ~ "male_sig",
        !is_sig80 & sex == "female" ~ "female_nonsig",
        !is_sig80 & sex == "male"   ~ "male_nonsig"
      )
    )
}

plot_df_simple_fecal3 <- extract_fecal3_simple_effects(fit_models_by_family_fecal3)

top_fams_simple_fecal3 <- plot_df_simple_fecal3 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Family) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(max_abs = max(abs(median)), .groups = "drop") %>%

plot_df_simple_fecal3 <- plot_df_simple_fecal3 %>%

# ---------- ST gastrointestinal sites at termination ----------
physeq_ST_comp_git <- physeq_ST_comp %>%
  subset_samples(timepoint == "t4") %>%
  rename_eub_family(rank = "Family")

models_site <- list()
dfs_site <- list()
ps_clr_site <- list()

for (site in c("stomach", "ileum", "colon")) {
  cat("Running site:", site, "\n")

  ps_site <- subset_samples(physeq_ST_comp_git, sample_type == site)
  ps_clr  <- clr_phyloseq(ps_site, tax_level = "Family")
  df_site <- ps_clr_to_long(ps_clr, tax_level = "Family")
  model   <- run_microbiome_model(df_site, tax_level = "Family")

  ps_clr_site[[site]] <- ps_clr
  dfs_site[[site]] <- df_site
  models_site[[site]] <- model
}

site_plots_simple <- list()
site_simple_tables <- list()

for (site in names(models_site)) {
  df_site <- dfs_site[[site]]
  model_site <- models_site[[site]]

  grid_site <- tidyr::expand_grid(
    Family    = levels(df_site$Family),
    sex       = levels(df_site$sex),
    treatment = levels(df_site$treatment),
    diet      = levels(df_site$diet)
  )

  preds_site <- model_site %>%
    add_epred_draws(newdata = grid_site, ndraws = 2000, re_formula = NULL)

  eff_simple_treat <- preds_site %>%
    group_by(.draw, Family, sex, diet, treatment) %>%
    summarise(mu = mean(.epred), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = treatment, values_from = mu) %>%
    mutate(effect = Hp - Ctrl) %>%
    group_by(Family, sex, diet) %>%
    summarise(
      median   = median(effect),
      CI_low   = quantile(effect, 0.025),
      CI_high  = quantile(effect, 0.975),
      CI80_low = quantile(effect, 0.10),
      CI80_high= quantile(effect, 0.90),
      Pd       = pmax(mean(effect > 0), mean(effect < 0)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(label = paste0("Treatment in ", diet), type = "Simple Effects")

  eff_simple_diet <- preds_site %>%
    group_by(.draw, Family, sex, treatment, diet) %>%
    summarise(mu = mean(.epred), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = diet, values_from = mu) %>%
    mutate(effect = HFD - CD) %>%
    group_by(Family, sex, treatment) %>%
    summarise(
      median   = median(effect),
      CI_low   = quantile(effect, 0.025),
      CI_high  = quantile(effect, 0.975),
      CI80_low = quantile(effect, 0.10),
      CI80_high= quantile(effect, 0.90),
      Pd       = pmax(mean(effect > 0), mean(effect < 0)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(label = paste0("Diet in ", treatment), type = "Simple Effects")

  plot_df_simple <- bind_rows(eff_simple_treat, eff_simple_diet) %>%
  mutate(
    site = site,
    is_sig80 = (CI80_low > 0 & CI80_high > 0) | (CI80_low < 0 & CI80_high < 0),
    is_sig95 = (CI_low > 0 & CI_high > 0) | (CI_low < 0 & CI_high < 0),
    color_group = case_when(
      is_sig80 & sex == "female"  ~ "female_sig",
      is_sig80 & sex == "male"    ~ "male_sig",
      !is_sig80 & sex == "female" ~ "female_nonsig",
      !is_sig80 & sex == "male"   ~ "male_nonsig"
    )
  )
  
  fam_order <- plot_df_simple %>%
    group_by(Family) %>%
    summarise(max_abs = max(abs(median)), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(max_abs)) %>%
    slice_head(n = 10) %>%
    pull(Family)

  plot_df_simple <- plot_df_simple %>%
    filter(Family %in% fam_order) %>%
    mutate(
      Family = factor(Family, levels = fam_order),
      label = factor(
        label,
        levels = c(
          "Diet in Hp",
          "Diet in Ctrl",
          "Treatment in HFD",
          "Treatment in CD"
        )
      )
    )

  site_simple_tables[[site]] <- plot_df_simple
  site_plots_simple[[site]] <- make_simple_effect_plot(plot_df_simple, title = site)
}

# ---------- ST Helicobacteraceae abundance vs Hp load ----------
phy_stomach_hp <- physeq_ST_comp_git %>%
  subset_samples(sample_type == "stomach" & treatment == "Hp") %>%
  transform_sample_counts(function(x) x / sum(x))

phy_family <- tax_glom(phy_stomach_hp, taxrank = "Family")

hel_df <- psmelt(phy_family) %>%
  filter(Family == "Helicobacteraceae") %>%
  select(Sample, Abundance) %>%
  mutate(sample_ID_clean = clean_sample_id(Sample))

meta_df <- data.frame(sample_data(phy_stomach_hp)) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Sample") %>%
  mutate(sample_ID_clean = clean_sample_id(Sample))

hel_df <- hel_df %>%
  inner_join(meta_df, by = "sample_ID_clean") %>%
  inner_join(MS1_Hp_loads_ST, by = "mouseID") %>%
  mutate(log10_Hp = log10(Hp_copies_std.x))

fit_relabund_hp <- brm(
  Abundance ~ log10_Hp,
  data = hel_df,
  family = gaussian(),
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
    prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sigma")
  ),
  chains = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 2000,
  seed = 123
)

posterior <- as_draws_df(fit_relabund_hp)

posterior %>%
  summarise(
    median = median(b_log10_Hp),
    CI_low = quantile(b_log10_Hp, 0.025),
    CI_high = quantile(b_log10_Hp, 0.975),
    prob_pos = mean(b_log10_Hp > 0)
  )

hel_df <- hel_df %>%
  mutate(
    Abundance_log = log10(Abundance + 1e-6),
    diet = factor(diet, levels = c("CD", "HFD")),
    sex  = factor(sex, levels = c("female", "male"))
  )

fit_relabund_hp_groups <- brm(
  Abundance_log ~ diet * sex + log10_Hp,
  data = hel_df,
  family = gaussian(),
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
    prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sigma")
  ),
  chains = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 2000,
  seed = 123
)

Hp_seq <- seq(
  min(hel_df$log10_Hp, na.rm = TRUE),
  max(hel_df$log10_Hp, na.rm = TRUE),
  length.out = 100
)

newdata <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  log10_Hp = Hp_seq,
  diet = levels(hel_df$diet),
  sex  = levels(hel_df$sex)
) %>%
  mutate(
    diet = factor(diet, levels = levels(hel_df$diet)),
    sex  = factor(sex, levels = levels(hel_df$sex))
  )

preds <- add_epred_draws(
  fit_relabund_hp_groups,
  newdata = newdata,
  re_formula = NA
)

preds_sum <- preds %>%
  group_by(diet, sex, log10_Hp) %>%
  summarise(
    median = median(.epred),
    CI_low = quantile(.epred, 0.025),
    CI_high = quantile(.epred, 0.975),
    CI80_low = quantile(.epred, 0.10),
    CI80_high = quantile(.epred, 0.90),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(preds_sum, aes(x = log10_Hp, y = median, color = diet, fill = diet)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = CI_low, ymax = CI_high), alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ sex) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("CD" = "#0072B2", "HFD" = "#D55E00")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("CD" = "#0072B2", "HFD" = "#D55E00")) +
  labs(
    x = "H. pylori load (log10)",
    y = "Helicobacteraceae abundance (log10)",
    color = "Diet",
    fill = "Diet"
  )

  sex == "male"

make_LT_fecal_top10_plot <- function(ps_obj, sex_label) {
  plot_nested_bar(
    ps_obj = ps_obj,
    top_level = "Phylum",
    nested_level = "Family",
    palette = c(
      Bacillota = "#00F034",
      Bacteroidota = "#008CF0",
      Desulfobacterota = "#ECF000",
      Verrucomicrobiota = "#CA0BE8"
    )
  ) +
    labs(x = "Mouse ID", y = "Relative abundance") +
    scale_y_continuous(sec.axis = sec_axis(~ ., name = sex_label)) +
    facet_nested(
      ~ treatment + weeks_on_diet,
      nest_line = element_line(linetype = 1),
      scales = "free_x",
      space = "free",
      labeller = labeller(
        treatment = c("Ctrl" = "Control", "Hp" = "italic('H. pylori')"),
        weeks_on_diet = c(
          "-1" = "'-1w'", "0" = "'0w'", "1" = "'1w'",
          "3" = "'3w'", "5" = "'5w'", "11" = "'11w'", "16" = "'16w'"
        ),
        .default = label_parsed
      )
    ) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y.right = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y.right = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      strip.text.x = element_text(color = "black", size = 16),
      legend.position = "none",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      panel.spacing = unit(0.75, "lines"),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "white", fill = NA, size = 0.5)
    )
}

plot_physeq_LT_comp_fecal_top10_families_females <- make_LT_fecal_top10_plot(

  "females"
)

plot_physeq_LT_comp_fecal_top10_families_males <- make_LT_fecal_top10_plot(

# ---------- LT site CLR models ----------
models_site_LT <- list()
dfs_site_LT <- list()
ps_clr_site_LT <- list()

for (site_name in c("stomach", "ileum", "colon", "cecum")) {
  cat("Running site:", site_name, "\n")

  ps_site_LT <- subset_samples(physeq_LT_comp_git, sample_site == site_name)

  if (length(sample_names(ps_site_LT)) == 0) next

  ps_clr_LT <- clr_phyloseq(ps_site_LT, tax_level = "Family")
  df_site_LT <- ps_clr_to_long(ps_clr_LT, tax_level = "Family")

  if (nrow(df_site_LT) == 0) next

  model_LT <- run_microbiome_model_no_diet(df_site_LT, tax_level = "Family")

  ps_clr_site_LT[[site_name]] <- ps_clr_LT
  dfs_site_LT[[site_name]] <- df_site_LT
  models_site_LT[[site_name]] <- model_LT
}

site_plots_simple_LT <- list()
site_simple_tables_LT <- list()

for (site in names(models_site_LT)) {
  df_site_LT <- dfs_site_LT[[site]]
  model_site_LT <- models_site_LT[[site]]

  grid_site_LT <- tidyr::expand_grid(
    Family = levels(df_site_LT$Family),
    sex = levels(df_site_LT$sex),
    treatment = levels(df_site_LT$treatment)
  )

  preds_site_LT <- model_site_LT %>%
    tidybayes::add_epred_draws(
      newdata = grid_site_LT,
      ndraws = 2000,
      re_formula = NULL
    )

  eff_treat_by_sex_LT <- preds_site_LT %>%
    group_by(.draw, Family, sex, treatment) %>%
    summarise(mu = mean(.epred), .groups = "drop") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = treatment, values_from = mu) %>%
    mutate(effect = Hp - Ctrl) %>%
    group_by(Family, sex) %>%
    summarise(
      median = median(effect),
      CI_low = quantile(effect, 0.025),
      CI_high = quantile(effect, 0.975),
      CI80_low = quantile(effect, 0.10),
      CI80_high = quantile(effect, 0.90),
      Pd = pmax(mean(effect > 0), mean(effect < 0)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      label = "Treatment effect",
      type = "Hp - Ctrl within sex"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      site = site,
      is_sig80 = (CI80_low > 0 & CI80_high > 0) | (CI80_low < 0 & CI80_high < 0),
      color_group = case_when(
        is_sig80 & sex == "female"  ~ "female_sig",
        is_sig80 & sex == "male"    ~ "male_sig",
        !is_sig80 & sex == "female" ~ "female_nonsig",
        !is_sig80 & sex == "male"   ~ "male_nonsig"
      )
    )

  fam_order_LT <- eff_treat_by_sex_LT %>%
    group_by(Family) %>%
    summarise(max_abs = max(abs(median)), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(max_abs)) %>%
    slice_head(n = 10) %>%
    pull(Family)

  plot_df_simple_LT <- eff_treat_by_sex_LT %>%
    filter(Family %in% fam_order_LT) %>%
    mutate(
      Family = factor(Family, levels = fam_order_LT),
      sex = factor(sex, levels = c("female", "male"))
    )

  p_simple_LT <- ggplot(plot_df_simple_LT, aes(x = sex, y = median, color = color_group)) +
    geom_linerange(
      aes(ymin = CI_low, ymax = CI_high),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.4),
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    geom_linerange(
      aes(ymin = CI80_low, ymax = CI80_high),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.4),
      linewidth = 1.8
    ) +
    geom_point(
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.4),
      size = 1.8
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    coord_flip() +
    facet_grid(rows = vars(Family)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = sex_sig_cols) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 8),
      strip.text.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "",
      y = "Treatment effect (Hp - Ctrl, CLR difference)",
      color = "Sex / Evidence",
      title = site
    )

  site_simple_tables_LT[[site]] <- plot_df_simple_LT
  site_plots_simple_LT[[site]] <- p_simple_LT
}

make_LT_target_df <- function(ps, target_families) {
  ps %>%
    transform_sample_counts(function(x) x / sum(x)) %>%
    tax_glom(taxrank = "Family") %>%
    psmelt() %>%
    mutate(
      Family = ifelse(is.na(Family) | Family == "", "Unclassified", as.character(Family))
    ) %>%
    filter(Family %in% target_families)
}

# ---------- LT Helicobacteraceae abundance vs Hp load ----------
phy_stomach_hp_LT <- physeq_LT_comp_git %>%
  subset_samples(sample_site == "stomach" & treatment == "Hp") %>%
  transform_sample_counts(function(x) x / sum(x))

phy_family_LT <- tax_glom(phy_stomach_hp_LT, taxrank = "Family")

hel_df_LT <- psmelt(phy_family_LT) %>%
  filter(Family == "Helicobacteraceae") %>%
  select(Sample, Abundance) %>%
  mutate(sample_ID_clean = clean_sample_id(Sample))

meta_df_LT <- data.frame(sample_data(phy_stomach_hp_LT)) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Sample") %>%
  mutate(sample_ID_clean = clean_sample_id(Sample))

hel_df_LT <- hel_df_LT %>%
  inner_join(meta_df_LT, by = "sample_ID_clean") %>%
  inner_join(MS1_Hp_loads_LT, by = "mouseID") %>%
  mutate(log10_Hp = log10(Hp_copies_std.x))

fit_relabund_hp_LT <- brm(
  Abundance ~ log10_Hp,
  data = hel_df_LT,
  family = gaussian(),
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
    prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sigma")
  ),
  chains = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 2000,
  seed = 123
)

posterior_LT <- as_draws_df(fit_relabund_hp_LT)

posterior_LT %>%
  summarise(
    median = median(b_log10_Hp),
    CI_low = quantile(b_log10_Hp, 0.025),
    CI_high = quantile(b_log10_Hp, 0.975),
    prob_pos = mean(b_log10_Hp > 0)
  )
```
